items.a: **Most vibe coders under-specify;** use a PRD with four thinking levels before building.
**Point AI at existing libraries;** ask AI to recommend frameworks if unsure; still learn frontend/backend structure.
**Git + GitHub; commit often;** can instruct agents in natural language ("commit and push to main").
**Copy-paste errors; be patient** through fix cycles; file-structure literacy helps when AI loops.
**PRD detail, mockups, screenshots,** full error text beat vague "this doesn't work".

items.q: What should you remember about chatGPT prompt shown on screen?
items.a: **help make PRD for** MVP with example PRD link (Google Doc in description).

items.q: What should you remember about four questions?
items.a: **what is the app, how do** I use it, patterns behind it, how to make it most useful.

items.q: What should you remember about refine scope?
items.a: **drop "nice to haves";** add measurable features (e.g. SEO score out of 100).

items.q: What should you remember about convert PRD → build prompt + image mockup before handing to Replit/Windsurf?
items.a: **Convert PRD → build** prompt + image mockup before handing to Replit/Windsurf.
**paste prompt + inspo image → fast build; ask** assistant to explain file structure while building; dev URL QR for mobile test; one change at a time when iterating.
**local env setup slower; accept terminal commands carefully** on local machine; initiate git for version control in natural language; often closer to mockup on first pass.

items.q: What should you remember about **MVP first**?
items.a: **Lavish multi-feature specs cause** errors and hair-pulling; ship core function then add.
